PRODUCT OVERVIEW

About the Super Seeder

A Super Seeder brings soil preparation and seed placement together. Its working parts manage surface residue, loosen the upper soil and place seed behind the tractor. It is commonly considered when a grower wants to establish the next crop after harvest with fewer separate field operations.

Common field uses

  • Sowing after a previous crop has been harvested
  • Working in fields with manageable surface residue
  • Reducing the number of separate preparation and sowing passes
IN THE FIELD

How it works

  1. 01

    Works through the upper soil and remaining crop residue.

  2. 02

    Places seed as the machine travels across the prepared field.

  3. 03

    Leaves the field ready for the next stage of crop establishment.
